item.title: Strait of Hormuz: Trump’s ultimatum to Iran
item.summary: Donald #Trump issued an ultimatum to #Iran on March 22: 48 hours to reopen the Strait of #Hormuz or the #US will strike Iranian oil facilities. Tehran has responded, warning it would retaliate.

item.summary: Gulf states are caught between a rock and a hard place, right now as the consider how to respond to the Iran's regime, dealing with a volley of attacks on critical infrastrure, and threats that continue.

item.title: Socialist frontrunner Emmanuel Grégoire elected Paris mayor, exit polls say
item.summary: Socialist frontrunner Emmanuel Grégoire was comfortably leading veteran conservative Rachida Dati in a second-round runoff for Paris mayor, exit polls showed Sunday, in the last major test of the French public mood ahead of next year’s all-important presidential election.

item.title: Voter turnout reaches 48,1% at 5pm in second round of municipal elections
item.summary: Voter turnout climbed to 48,1 percent at 5pm Sunday's second round of council elections, a slight decrease compared to last Sunday's turnout at the same time which reached 48,9 percent. FRANCE 24's Antonia Kerrigan reports from Paris.
